## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated work.
- [ ] Tests or validation cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] User-facing changes consider keyboard and accessibility behavior.
- [ ] Platform-specific behavior and untested platforms are clearly identified.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or generated build artifacts are included.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are clearly described, or this change is not breaking.
